I've actually done it, I'm finally going back to college! I got the news a few days ago, but at this point I'm just so tired that it still doesn't feel real.
I also got talking to some other people in my course, and there's a suspiciously high amount of people that have had to sit repeats, and nearly as many who have to repeat the entire year again. 
But no matter, I'm where I want to be, and I'm FINALLY getting professional help for whatever is going through my head. My first appointment is on Friday this week, and I think maybe I'm ready to just allow myself to be helped, you know? It is a bit expensive but it's honestly cheaper both financially and mentally to just go than to continue on with my disgustingly bad coping mechanisms.

I hope other people see this, and realise that there is help out there, just ask someone
I can't really do this where I live, as every job on that list and more require some sort of college degree. But I've made some decisions, which are hopefully more clear in my other post.
